pod-api.json.structure: Kubernetes Pod JSON returned by read-only GET. Contains metadata, container image/argv, node selector, required anti-affinity, resource requests and observed scheduling status.
pod-api.json.sensitive_fields: No secret values; retain exact API response.

events-api.json.structure: Kubernetes Events list filtered to the exact Pod name. Includes event reason, message, timestamps, count and involved-object identity.

scheduling-receipt.json.structure: Job and Pod UIDs, state, resource placement requirements, scheduler messages, results-prefix observation and whether computation began. `data_generated=false` means this is execution-state evidence only.

DATA_INDEX.json.structure: Relative path, byte count, SHA-256 and media type for every other file in this directory.

hash_rule: SHA-256 is over exact file bytes; the index does not hash itself.
